SELECT 
  'database' as check_name,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(*) >= 0 THEN 'OK' ELSE 'FAIL' END as status,
  NOW() as checked_at
FROM candidate_sessions
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_sessions,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'in_progress') as active_sessions,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'completed') as completed_sessions,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE started_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours') as sessions_today,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE started_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour') as sessions_last_hour
FROM candidate_sessions

SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_approved,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours') as approved_today
FROM approved_candidates

SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as errors_last_hour,
  MAX(timestamp) as last_error_time
FROM error_logs
WHERE timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour'

INSERT INTO health_checks (
  timestamp,
  overall_status,
  total_sessions,
  active_sessions,
  sessions_today,
  errors_last_hour,
  approved_today
) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7)
